symptoms: Check engine light, rough idle, reduced power
likely_causes: Vacuum leak, dirty MAF sensor, fuel filter clogged
diagnostic_steps: 1. Scan for P0171. 2. Inspect vacuum hoses for leaks. 3. Clean MAF sensor with MAF cleaner. 4. Check fuel pressure.

symptoms: Engine misfire, shaking, loss of power
likely_causes: Worn spark plugs, ignition coil failure, fuel injector leak
diagnostic_steps: 1. Scan for P0300. 2. Perform cylinder balance test. 3. Inspect and replace spark plugs. 4. Test ignition coils.

symptoms: Check engine light, reduced fuel economy
likely_causes: Failing catalytic converter, upstream O2 sensor malfunction, exhaust leak
diagnostic_steps: 1. Scan for P0420. 2. Inspect O2 sensor readings. 3. Perform exhaust leak check. 4. Test catalyst efficiency with temperature probe.

issue_name: Evaporative Emission System Leak Detected (Large Leak)
likely_causes: Loose fuel cap, cracked EVAP hose, faulty charcoal canister
diagnostic_steps: 1. Verify DTC P0455. 2. Tighten fuel cap. 3. Perform smoke test on EVAP system. 4. Replace damaged hose or canister if needed.

symptoms: Check engine light, poor fuel economy
likely_causes: Heater circuit open, blown fuse, sensor failure
diagnostic_steps: 1. Scan for P0141. 2. Check heater circuit fuse. 3. Measure voltage at sensor connector. 4. Replace O2 sensor if defective.

issue_name: Intake Air Temperature Sensor Circuit High Input
likely_causes: Sensor shorted, wiring issue, sensor failure
diagnostic_steps: 1. Scan for P0113. 2. Inspect wiring harness for damage. 3. Test sensor resistance. 4. Replace IAT sensor if out of spec.

issue_name: Coolant Thermostat (Coolant Temperature Below Thermostat Regulating Temperature)
symptoms: Engine runs cold, increased fuel consumption
likely_causes: Stuck open thermostat, low coolant level
diagnostic_steps: 1. Scan for P0128. 2. Check coolant level. 3. Measure coolant temperature at radiator. 4. Replace thermostat if temperature does not rise above 195°F.

diagnostic_steps: 1. Scan for P0500. 2. Verify VSS signal with oscilloscope. 3. Inspect wiring and connectors. 4. Replace VSS if signal absent.

diagnostic_steps: 1. Scan for P0700 and related codes. 2. Check TCM power and ground. 3. Perform transmission fluid check. 4. Replace or reprogram TCM as needed.

symptoms: Gear selection problems, transmission warning light
likely_causes: Faulty range sensor, wiring short, connector issue
diagnostic_steps: 1. Scan for P0705. 2. Verify sensor output with multimeter. 3. Inspect wiring harness. 4. Replace range sensor if out of spec.

issue_name: Throttle Actuator Control Motor Circuit Range/Performance Problem
symptoms: Rough idle, throttle lag, check engine light
likely_causes: Dirty throttle body, motor failure, wiring fault
diagnostic_steps: 1. Scan for P2101. 2. Perform throttle body cleaning. 3. Test motor resistance. 4. Replace throttle body motor if needed.

symptoms: Check engine light, black smoke, poor fuel economy
likely_causes: Leaking injector, high fuel pressure, O2 sensor fault
diagnostic_steps: 1. Scan for P2210. 2. Perform injector balance test. 3. Check fuel pressure. 4. Replace leaking injector.

issue_name: Hybrid Battery Pack Temperature Sensor Fault
symptoms: Hybrid system warning, reduced power, check engine light
likely_causes: Faulty temperature sensor, wiring issue, battery cell imbalance
diagnostic_steps: 1. Scan for P0A8C. 2. Read sensor voltage. 3. Inspect wiring harness. 4. Replace temperature sensor or service battery pack.
